answer: The delta schedule is applied in atlas and lotus shows each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3416 identities would post 1170 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
